title: Sets with Few Subset Sums
summary: It is a classical fact that every $n$-element set of positive reals has at least $\binom{n+1}{2}+1$ distinct subset sums, with equality exactly for homogeneous arithmetic progressions (when $n\geq 4$). We establish stability versions of this inverse theorem in two regimes. First, for any parameter $M \leq n-4$, we precisely characterize the $n$-element sets of positive reals with at most $\binom{n+1}{2}+1+M$ subset sums.
